title: Notion Pricing Plans: Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise.

facts.fact: Notion's Free plan is priced at $0 per member per month.
facts.quote: $0per member / month

facts.fact: Notion's Plus plan is priced at $10 per member per month.
facts.quote: $10per member / month

facts.fact: Notion's Business plan is priced at $20 per member per month.
facts.quote: $20per member / month

facts.fact: Notion's Enterprise plan has custom pricing and is sold through a sales contact rather than a published price.
facts.quote: Custom pricing

facts.fact: Notion states that paying yearly can save up to 20% compared with paying monthly.
facts.quote: Save up to 20% with yearly

facts.fact: Notion prices its pricing page in US dollars.
facts.quote: Price inUSD

facts.fact: Notion's Custom Agents are free to try, then cost $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits.
facts.quote: Free to try, then $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits.

facts.fact: On Notion's Free plan, uploaded files are limited to 5 MB each.
facts.quote: you can upload images, videos and file attachments up to 5 MB each

facts.fact: Notion's paid plans allow file uploads up to 5 GB each.
facts.quote: Upgrade to a paid plan to upload files up to 5 GB each.

facts.fact: Notion states that for Enterprise plan workspaces, its LLM providers use zero data retention when Notion AI is used.
facts.quote: our LLM providers utilize zero data retention for Enterprise plan workspaces

facts.fact: Notion's Free plan includes a trial of Notion AI.
facts.quote: Trial of Notion AI

facts.fact: Notion's Business plan includes SAML SSO for managing employee access at scale.
facts.quote: Manage employee access at scale with secure single sign-on.

facts.fact: Notion's Business plan offers Enterprise Search, which is labeled Beta.
facts.quote: Enterprise SearchBeta

facts.fact: Notion's Workers feature is labeled Beta.
facts.quote: Workers**Beta

facts.fact: Notion's Business plan is labeled as Recommended.
facts.quote: BusinessRecommended

facts.fact: Notion's Free plan is described as being for individuals to organize personal projects and life.
facts.quote: For individuals to organize personal projects and life.

facts.fact: Notion's Plus plan is described as being for small teams and professionals to work together.
facts.quote: For small teams and professionals to work together.

facts.fact: Notion's Business plan is described as being for growing businesses to streamline teamwork.
facts.quote: For growing businesses to streamline teamwork.

facts.fact: Notion's Enterprise plan is described as being for organizations that need scalability, control, and security.
facts.quote: For organizations to operate with scalability, control, and security.

facts.fact: Notion's Free plan allows teams of 2+ members to be limited in pages and blocks.
facts.quote: Limited for 2+ members

facts.fact: Notion defines blocks as pieces of content added to a page, such as to-do checkboxes, paragraphs, and bullet points.
facts.quote: Blocks are pieces of content you add to a page (e.g. to-do checkboxes, paragraphs, bullet points, etc.).

facts.fact: Notion's Enterprise plan includes a detailed audit log of security and safety-related activity for the workspace account.
facts.quote: Access a detailed log of security and safety-related activity for your workspace account

facts.fact: Notion's Enterprise plan includes SCIM API access for provisioning and managing users and groups.
facts.quote: Access the Notion SCIM API to provision and manage users and groups.

facts.fact: Notion's Business plan lets teams create private teamspaces that only added members can see or discover.
facts.quote: Create teamspaces that can’t be seen or discovered by anyone except those you add.
